description:
Create a new local Maven repository in JFrog Artifactory named 'legacy-dev-local'. This repository must be configured to support legacy build tools by setting the 'Maven Snapshot Version Behavior' to 'Non-unique'. 

Starting from the Artifactory Home, navigate to the Administration module, then to Repositories > Local. Create a new Maven repository with the Repository Key 'legacy-dev-local'. In the Maven Settings section of the setup form, ensure 'Handle Snapshots' is enabled, and critically, change the 'Maven Snapshot Version Behavior' from the default 'Unique' to 'Non-unique'. Save the repository.
